title: Pressure Lab
objectives: Use the rule Pressure = Force ÷ Area
Choose small or large area for a job

stages.title: The Vault Door
stages.narration: Brute force won't open the vault. Professor Mass whispers: 'Think about area!'

steps.text: Newton Bot hands you a single sharp pin.

stages.title: More or Less Pressure?
stages.prompt: For the same force, does each design give MORE or LESS pressure?

tasks.label: A thin, sharp knife edge
tasks.explain: Small area → high pressure, so it cuts.

tasks.label: Wide flat skis
tasks.explain: Large area → low pressure, so you don't sink.

tasks.label: A pointed needle tip
tasks.explain: Tiny area → very high pressure, so it pierces.

tasks.label: A wide backpack strap
tasks.explain: Large area spreads force → low pressure, comfy shoulders.

stages.title: Which Tools Use HIGH Pressure?
stages.prompt: Tap every tool that works by making a SMALL area (high pressure).

feedback.correct: Yes! A small sharp area gives high pressure to cut or pierce.
feedback.incorrect: This uses a LARGE area to LOWER pressure instead.

stages.title: Mini-Boss: Pierce the Lock
stages.prompt: Score 80% to focus your force to a point and win shard 4!

questions.explain: Pressure is force divided by area.

questions.q: A sharp knife cuts because its edge has…
questions.explain: Small area → high pressure → cuts easily.

questions.q: Skis stop you sinking in snow by…
options: spreading weight over a large area
questions.explain: Large area lowers pressure so you stay on top.

questions.q: The unit of pressure is the…

stages.title: Momentum Shard 4 Charged!
messages: 🏅 You earned the Pressure Pro badge
⚡ Momentum Core: 4 of 8 shards charged — halfway!
One sharp point cracked the vault wide open!
